extension.name: eWay Recurring Playwright stub
extension.description: Test support only. Replaces eWAY's HTTP service with a fake that answers from a queue kept in a CiviCRM setting, so browser tests can script what eWAY says. Never install it on a real site.
extension.comments: Used by tests/playwright in au.com.agileware.ewayrecurring. Needs that extension's Utils::setHttpServiceFactory().
